mobbin:2b3f4914-5fd3-49bc-8f83-32b7fcab6.summary: From Home, the user opens Live Notes on a LIVE recording banner, sees AI Notes still writing plus AskFred shortcuts, then works a live Transcript with REC indicator, assist buttons, and AskFred Q&A.
steps: Home — LIVE banner + Live Notes CTA + Stop
AI Notes empty — writing… + AskFred Catch me up
Live Assist — REC, transcript, Suggested Questions / Catch up
steal: Global LIVE banner with session title, start time, Live Notes CTA, and Stop (step 1) — recording state visible outside the player.
AI Notes empty state: 'writing notes… points will appear here automatically' (step 2) — sets expectation while STT waits.
Catch me up (Last 1 min) + Suggest Questions / Summarize so far / Action items as primary assists (steps 2–3) — faculty re-entry without scrubbing.
Live transcript with speaker initials, clickable timestamps, Scroll to bottom (step 3) — SRV Transcript during recording, not only after.
avoid: Deal-centric AskFred prompts ('Ask anything across your deal') (steps 2–3) — wrong domain framing for clinical sim; keep assists clinical/scenario-scoped.
mobbin:2b3f4914-5fd3-49bc-8f83-32b7fcab6.fit: Would add a live Annotation/Transcript mode to SRV (and a Center Overview LIVE strip) with AI markers filling during the session and Catch-me-up for faculty who stepped away.

mobbin:f1e15c44-a1fc-4eee-8644-7320cbca5.summary: In post-meeting review, the user selects a transcript span (highlighted), bookmarks it so a star appears on the timeline, with AI summary/notes linking to the same timestamps.
steps: Bookmarked span — pink highlight + star on timeline
steal: Select-in-transcript to bookmark (step 1→2) — annotation from Transcript tab text, not only from the marker track.
Star marker on the progress bar aligned to the bookmarked moment (step 2) — one clear pin, reduces marker collision risk.
AI Notes bullets with blue jump timestamps (steps 1–2) — summary ↔ seek like SRV chapters.
mobbin:f1e15c44-a1fc-4eee-8644-7320cbca5.fit: Would extend SRV Transcript: select text → pin a single timeline star (and Annotation entry) instead of stacking more overlapping speech-bubble markers.
